# MageLift

MageLift is an Apache-2.0 CLI for running Magento Open Source and licensed Adobe Commerce in the shop’s own cloud account. A PHP project defines services for staging, UAT, production and pull-request previews. The shop chooses service versions and pays the cloud provider.

- Getting started: https://magelift.dev/docs/getting-started/
- Install from source: https://magelift.dev/docs/install/
- Cloud targets and evidence: https://magelift.dev/docs/capability-matrix/
- Service families and existing endpoints: https://magelift.dev/docs/service-bindings/
- Connect a headless storefront: https://magelift.dev/docs/storefront-recipes/
- Migrate from Adobe Commerce Cloud or Upsun: https://magelift.dev/docs/migrating-from-paas/
- Pricing: https://magelift.dev/pricing.md
- Operations: https://magelift.dev/docs/operations/
- FAQ: https://magelift.dev/docs/faq/
- Source and support: https://github.com/magelift/magelift
- Extended summary: https://magelift.dev/llms-full.txt
